messages.subject: Function for buildXi2els_C2
parts:
Hi Phil,

I'm trying to fully understand the code to estimate C2 in MIRT. However, I can't find the function 'buildXi2els_C2' anywhere. This function seems crucial for the C2 estimation. Where can I find the function? What exactly does the function do?

(For background: I tried to implement the C2 function from the Cai & Monroe (2014) paper in Python, but I presumably made some mistakes there as the values were too large. So, I would like to fully understand the C2 code from MIRT to better understand where my mistakes might be coming from.)

Thank you very much!
Katharina

Hi Katharina,

You'd have to sift through the C++ code in the package to find the implementations, though to answer your question this relates to building the model-implied first and second moments of the data. https://github.com/philchalmers/mirt/blob/main/src/Misc.cpp

Phil
